keyPoints.en: Tables need a title, row and column headings, units and a source; they show exact values.
keyPoints.bm: Jadual perlu tajuk, tajuk baris dan lajur, unit dan sumber; ia menunjukkan nilai tepat.

keyPoints.en: Bar graph: compare amounts. Line graph: change over time. Combined graph: two related data sets.
keyPoints.bm: Graf bar: bandingkan jumlah. Graf garisan: perubahan mengikut masa. Graf gabungan: dua set data berkaitan.

keyPoints.en: Steps: title → headings → enter data with units → add source.
keyPoints.bm: Langkah: tajuk → tajuk lajur → masukkan data dengan unit → tambah sumber.

keyPoints.en: Draw and label axes, choose a scale with equal intervals, plot bars (equal width/gaps) or points joined by a line, add title, key and source.
keyPoints.bm: Lukis dan labelkan paksi, pilih skala dengan selang sama, plot bar (lebar/jarak sama) atau titik yang disambung garisan, tambah tajuk, petunjuk dan sumber.

tip.en: A combined graph has two vertical axes.
tip.bm: Graf gabungan mempunyai dua paksi menegak.

keyPoints.en: Describe highest and lowest values, trend and differences; calculate range, average or percentage change; always use units.
keyPoints.bm: Huraikan nilai tertinggi dan terendah, trend dan perbezaan; kira julat, purata atau peratus perubahan; sentiasa gunakan unit.
